keys.route: HTTP route and its controller line
keys.fn: service function that does the work
keys.needs: what must exist first, with the refusal code when it is missing
keys.inputs: derivable (record.field) | officer (which judgement) | guard (request key, expected revision, digest)

keys.studio: Studio component that calls it, or nothing
keys.human: code = the code requires a reviewer; convention = only the screen or habit does

principal: Every USP route builds one local operator: roles ['operator'], mode local_demo.
So no command can require a second person or a second role; actor checks require the SAME subject.
snapshotRule: usp/snapshots captures the whole site: records with revision>0, physical features with revision>0,
every source of every case of the site; 1000 records, 1000 features, 2000 sources, else 413 USP_SCOPE_LIMIT.
Target selection is 1 to 100 pins, else USP_SELECTION; an absent or changed pin is 409 USP_STALE_TARGET.
Identity, declarations and proposals recapture and compare the digest, so ANY later source in ANY case of
the site stales them: a site-wide form of B1. cite packages/server/src/modules/usp/snapshots.ts:226-230

officer: acknowledgement text: the officer's statement that the records are right
